## UpdateQueue class

Update queue — in-memory bounded FIFO for sequential processing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class UpdateQueue<T = unknown> 
```

## Remarks

Provides a bounded FIFO queue for Telegram updates, ensuring they are processed sequentially. Shared by both deploy modes: webhook/serverless enqueue from HTTP requests, polling enqueues from the `getUpdates` loop. Useful for long-polling fallback or rate-limited processing.
